investigation_notes.Description: Anomalously large amount of high-entropy DNS traffic was observed from host-812-workstation (192.168.177.244) to an external IP, using domain contentdelivery.net with several httpcache-like subdomains. DNS payloads (953 bytes) far exceed typical DNS query sizes (46 bytes), indicating potential DNS tunneling or covert data exfiltration. The internal source and external destination, combined with the unusual query pattern, make this a high-priority incident requiring immediate investigation.
